title: The Mock Coronation
text: The apostates are crowning a goat as the Ruler of the Pact, robed in stolen velvet, its horns gilded. The crowd howls with laughter. They want a noble to place the crown, for the joke of it, and they have noticed your colours.

options.label: The shrewdest plays along and crowns the goat, for the sake of passage.

outcomes.text: The court roars with laughter and lets you through as friends. Somewhere, the joke is heard, and something takes it seriously.

options.label: Refuse with dignity. You will not mock the Pact for anyone's amusement.

outcomes.text: They are offended. Then they are armed.

options.label: Steal the crown in the uproar, while everyone is laughing.

outcomes.text: Real gold, under the paint, and the whole mob after you, and they are not laughing now.
